synthesis.climate_context: Shared Melbourne-metro temperate climate — rain, mud and grit tracked into high-traffic entrances, foyers and washrooms; general Melbourne context, not a suburb-specific measured claim.
synthesis.building_stock: Affluent, established inner-eastern suburb bordering the Yarra River; noted for grand 19th-century Italianate mansions (e.g. Raheen, Villa Alba) and streets with exceptional Edwardian, Victorian and contemporary architecture; among the highest residential resale values in Melbourne. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kew,_Victoria]

retail_centres: Kew Junction — the suburb's main commercial precinct, which 'began to take shape in the 1850s', with shops appearing along High Street from the late 1850s [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kew,_Victoria]

Kew Junction, per the council's own description, 'offers an eclectic mix of specialty shops, cosy neighbourhood cafes, professional and health services, supermarkets and fresh produce stores' [source: https://www.boroondara.vic.gov.au/explore-boroondara/markets-and-shopping/kew-junction]

Kew Junction is a designated activity centre under the Victorian Government's Activity Centres Program (Amendment GC270, new planning controls from 31 March 2026) [source: https://www.boroondara.vic.gov.au/services/planning-and-building/planning/planning-scheme-and-amendments/victorian-government-planning-initiatives/victorian-government-changes-planning/activity-centre-updates-kew-and-hawthorn]
Cotham Village commercial precinct at the junction of Glenferrie and Cotham roads — a heritage-recognised group of shops [source: https://vhd.heritagecouncil.vic.gov.au/index.php/places/202254]
office_or_business_precincts: Kew Junction Activity Centre — the Kew Junction Structure Plan 'sets out guidelines for built form, height, land use, character, heritage, traffic, parking, and access in the Kew Junction Activity Centre', implemented via the Kew Junction Activity Centre Policy and Design and Development Overlay Schedule 14 [source: https://www.boroondara.vic.gov.au/services/planning-and-building/planning/planning-controls-and-strategies/shopping-and-commercial-areas]
The former Kew railway station site is now the headquarters of VicRoads [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kew,_Victoria]

Kew Junction includes 'professional and health services' alongside retail, per the council's description [source: https://www.boroondara.vic.gov.au/explore-boroondara/markets-and-shopping/kew-junction]

Historic civic and banking buildings at Kew Junction — the former post office, court house and police station, and the National Bank at the corner of Walpole and High Streets, all built in 1888 [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kew,_Victoria]
institutions: St Vincent's Private Hospital - Kew, 5 Studley Avenue, Kew 3101 [source: https://www.healthdirect.gov.au/australian-health-services/healthcare-service/kew-3101-vic/st-vincent-s-private-hospital-kew/hospitals/08a74c7c-8160-3da1-1a3a-1018edec2e4d]

Adeney Private Hospital, 209 Cotham Road, Kew 3101 [source: https://www.healthdirect.gov.au/australian-health-services/healthcare-service/kew-3101-vic/adeney-private-hospital/hospitals/2113b876-df15-4bd5-85f4-c6495dcfbe09]

St George's Health Service Kew — 'provides a comprehensive aged care service, including inpatient care, evaluation and management, residential aged care, rehabilitation, acute psychiatry, as well as a broad range of community-based assessment and treatment services' [source: https://vahi.vic.gov.au/hospital-and-health-services/st-georges-health-service-kew]
Preshil, The Margaret Lyttle Memorial School [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kew,_Victoria]
Kew High School, Kew Primary School and Sacred Heart Primary School [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kew,_Victoria]

Of Kew's education density it was said in 1960: 'it would be difficult to find any locality so richly endowed with so many and such large educational institutions as are to be found in Kew.' [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kew,_Victoria]
Villa Alba Museum, open to the public [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kew,_Victoria]

Hotels and licensed venues of long standing at Kew Junction including Hotel Kew (formerly the Clifton, 1869) and the Skinny Dog Hotel (formerly the Greyhound, 1874); the former Prospect Hill Hotel is now a Dan Murphy's liquor store [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kew,_Victoria]
hospitality_strips: Kew Junction / High Street — council describes 'cosy neighbourhood cafes' and 'a wonderful selection of restaurants' among its specialty shops and produce stores [source: https://www.boroondara.vic.gov.au/explore-boroondara/markets-and-shopping/kew-junction]
Long-established hotels along the Kew Junction strip: Hotel Kew (1869) and the Skinny Dog Hotel (1874) [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kew,_Victoria]
commercial_anchors.commercial_summary: Kew (City of Boroondara, postcode 3101) sits 5 km east of the CBD and concentrates its business premises in the Kew Junction activity centre around High Street, which the council describes as an eclectic mix of specialty shops, neighbourhood cafes, restaurants, supermarkets, fresh produce stores and professional and health services; a second heritage retail node sits at Cotham Village where Glenferrie and Cotham roads meet. Office and institutional demand comes from the Kew Junction professional-services cluster, the historic 1888 civic and bank buildings at the Junction, and the VicRoads headquarters on the former Kew railway station site. Kew also carries an unusually heavy healthcare and education load for a residential suburb: St Vincent's Private Hospital on Studley Avenue, Adeney Private Hospital on Cotham Road and St George's Health Service (aged care, rehabilitation and psychiatry), plus a large cluster of independent schools including Xavier College, MLC, Carey, Trinity, Ruyton, Genazzano and Preshil. No industrial estate was identified in Kew.
